name: Silk
description: WebGL2 silk fabric background with flowing folds, soft sheen, glow and film grain. Reacts to the pointer with a bend, moving light and click ripples, and has a light mode.
contents: Container div holding a full-size WebGL canvas that renders the animated silk surface
behavior: Folds flow continuously at a speed set by the speed prop
Intro animation unfolds the fabric and fades it in over about 2.2 seconds
Pointer over the page bends the fabric, drags it with movement and tilts the light toward the cursor
Clicks inside the component send a ripple ring across the fabric, up to 4 at once
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden, and idles when nothing is moving
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing flow, intro and pointer effects
Glow is a bloom pass rendered at quarter resolution
editableByProps: Fabric color, sheen color, and dark or light rendering through lightMode
Flow speed, pause, fold scale, rotation, wave, ripple and a variation seed for different patterns
Depth, sheen, glow and grain intensity
Pointer interaction, interaction strength, click ripples and the intro animation
Edge fade to transparent, pixel ratio, sizing through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the light direction at rest
Change intro duration or click ripple lifetime
Change the fold pattern or ripple strength of clicks
needsCodeEdit.where: silk and bend functions inside the SILK shader string

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the size of the pointer bend area
needsCodeEdit.where: 0.32 argument of the uPointer uniform in setShared

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable
Fills its parent, so the parent needs a defined height
Pointer and click listeners are attached to the window, so interaction works over content layered above it
Uses a hardcoded pointer bend area, light tilt and a maximum of 4 simultaneous ripples
Canvas is aria-hidden and purely decorative
Resizes with its container, works on mobile but is GPU heavy on low-end phones and has no touch hover, so interaction is tap ripples and touch moves only
